beforeEveryWrite: verify target branch is exactly kimi
fetch latest kimi head and tree
read project instructions and active change control before lower canon
inspect task Acceptance and pending differences
stop with BLOCKED when verification is unavailable or contradictory

sourceOfTruthOrder: task Acceptance, critics, judge, handover and deployment evidence
lower canonical documents and Step 2 executable contract
chat history, uploaded references and competitor materials
sessionPreflight: identify the exact task and current authorized step
read project source then active change control before sealed or lower canon
verify latest commit/tree and deployment relationship
define or load Acceptance Matrix before modification
state IN_PROGRESS, BLOCKED or PASS from evidence
productionLoop: define expected result, comparison target, failure conditions, environment and evidence
research material facts from current primary sources
inspect the actual artifact where applicable
audit code, data, economy, probability, backend, privacy and maintainability
run independent critics that attempt rejection
bind evidence to exact kimi commit/tree/deployment
allow final judge PASS only after all gates pass

requiredGates: G5 normal end-to-end use and recovery
G7 economy probability and long-term progression
G9 mobile and physical-device evidence where applicable
completionContract.userRejectionRule: Any user rejection returns the rejected scope to IN_PROGRESS.
completionContract.passAuthority: Only the final judge may issue PASS after creator and independent critic evidence is complete.

roles.creator: Produces against Acceptance and does not self-certify.
roles.independentCritic: Attempts to reject using product expectations, comparisons and edge cases.
roles.finalJudge: Ignores effort and checks only exact evidence.

userIsOnlyNeededFor: credentials or contracts unavailable to ChatGPT
destructive, paid, publishing or public-scope approval
physical iPhone evidence unavailable to tools
userBoundary.forbiddenDelegation: Do not ask the user to write code, diagnose ordinary defects or act as default QA.
